Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.domain

Record Class LedgerPosting

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.domain.LedgerPosting
Record Components:
postingId - unique identity of this immutable ledger event
operationId - idempotency scope shared by postings from one business operation
walletId - wallet liability account affected by this event
asset - validated asset ticker or ledger unit
movementType - canonical semantic kind of the balance change
amountSats - positive magnitude of the movement in satoshis
fromBucket - source bucket, or null for an external credit
toBucket - destination bucket, or null for a settled debit
reason - optional human-readable business explanation
correlationId - optional trace/group identifier connecting related operations
causationId - optional command/event identity that initiated this posting
createdAt - timestamp assigned when the posting is created
public record LedgerPosting(UUID postingId, UUID operationId, UUID walletId, String asset, LedgerMovementType movementType, long amountSats, LedgerBucket fromBucket, LedgerBucket toBucket, String reason, UUID correlationId, UUID causationId, Instant createdAt) extends Record
Immutable double-entry-facing posting record. Corrections are new postings.

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
